title: Ten Minutes by Tractor, Terroir Masterclass
summary: An intimate hosted tasting listed at 11am daily in Ten Minutes by Tractor's private room. Explore the character of its Mornington Peninsula vineyards through two limited-release and six current-release wines; book an available session.
venueName: Ten Minutes by Tractor Cellar Door
recurrenceNote: Operator lists 11am daily; book a specific available session
suitableFor: Adults 18+; wine enthusiasts; couples; small groups
accessibilityNotes: Cellar door fully accessible (wheelchair; stroller; transport accessible)
nearbyAttractions: Montalto; Paringa Estate; Merricks General Wine Store
suggestedItineraryPairing: Combine with lunch at TMBT Restaurant or Allis Wine Bar; add Merricks General Store for afternoon
editorVerdict: A deeper hosted tasting for people interested in how the Peninsula's vineyards shape Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.
editorNote:
The operator lists an 11am daily Terroir Masterclass in its private tasting room. Its current description covers the vineyards and regional history, with two limited-release and six current-release wines.

Book an available dated session directly with the operator before building an itinerary around it. A Main Ridge lunch can follow a confirmed class.
